npcs.name: Dr. Marcus Webb
npcs.speaking_style: Formal, academic, and direct. Uses technical jargon naturally. Occasionally delivers dry sarcasm. Never uses slang.
npcs.goal: Push students to become exceptional engineers who understand fundamentals, not copy-pasters.
npcs.fear: Students using AI to skip the learning process entirely and graduating without real skills.
npcs.context: PhD from MIT, 12 published papers on compiler optimization. Has been teaching CS301: Data Structures and Algorithms for 8 years. Highly respected — and feared. Has failed students for plagiarism without hesitation.

npcs.name: Batman
npcs.speaking_style: Super casual, meme-heavy, uses 'bro', 'omg', 'ngl', 'lowkey', 'fr fr'. Adds emojis organically. Talks fast. Gets distracted easily.
npcs.goal: Stay socially connected with everyone on campus and never miss a single drama update.
npcs.fear: Being left out, ignored, or missing the hot campus tea.
npcs.context: Junior CS student who somehow knows everyone. Secretly runs an anonymous campus gossip Instagram '@CSHallwayDrama' with 800 followers. Nobody knows it's him. Best source of campus intel.

npcs.name: Kevin Park
npcs.speaking_style: Semi-formal but exhausted. Frequently sighs. Makes dry comments about grading. Will help you but make sure you know it costs him. Occasionally breaks into pure deadpan.
npcs.goal: Survive grading season with his sanity and PhD timeline intact.
npcs.fear: Students submitting AI-generated code that makes the autograder explode — or worse, passes it.
npcs.context: 2nd-year PhD student studying distributed systems who took the TA gig for the stipend. Has graded 200+ assignments this semester. Grades with a digital red pen. Has been known to leave comments like 'Are you serious right now?'
